ideas.pitch: A split-architecture system where Laptop A runs structured RAG and reasoning agents over agricultural databases, and Laptop B hosts an interactive terminal interface, connected over a local websocket bridge to survive live unseen scenario shifts.
ideas.problem_statement: Construct TERRAFORM from scratch across two laptops simultaneously: one building the Knowledge Base and the other building the Interface, wired together into a cohesive system.
ideas.title: Terraform-Sync: Dual-Laptop Distributed Knowledge-Interface Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the core hackathon constraint by building the exact dual-laptop architecture requested, proving that deep structured knowledge reasoning and the user interface can talk to each other seamlessly during live evaluation.

ideas.pitch: An AI reasoning engine powered by structured knowledge graphs that dynamically recalculates treatment plans when handed unfamiliar, unseen land scenarios instead of relying on hardcoded lookup tables.
ideas.problem_statement: Each team is assigned one of five distinct land scenarios, and at judging time, they are handed a brand-new, unseen variation of it to test genuine system reasoning.
ideas.title: AgriReason: Zero-Shot Soil and Crop Adaptation Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the explicit judging trap where judges hand over brand-new, unseen land variations, proving the AI reasons from first principles rather than memorizing pre-baked database templates.

ideas.pitch: A retro terminal-style interface for Laptop B that parses plain-English distress inputs from a stranded user, queries the Laptop A knowledge backend, and renders actionable step-by-step agricultural commands.
ideas.problem_statement: Construct the Interface, the face users actually interact with, wired to a deep knowledge base to walk a user from bare soil to a full harvest.
ideas.title: Terraform-CLI: The Command-Line Survival Interface
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a fully working live demo with high thematic polish and zero latency, directly matching the survivalist persona of waking up on unknown land with a single tool.

ideas.pitch: A structured research database designed for Laptop A that maps soil chemistry, moisture retention, and climate variables into a multi-hop reasoning schema for rapid AI querying.
ideas.problem_statement: One team building the Knowledge Base — deep, structured research that lets an AI genuinely reason about soil, treatment, and crops.
ideas.title: SoilGraph: Multi-Hop Knowledge Base for Agronomic Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses intensely on the quality of the knowledge foundation, ensuring the reasoning agent has rigorous domain data to draw upon when faced with unexpected judge scenarios.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end integration wrapper that synchronizes the knowledge base and interface laptops, converting raw soil sensor inputs or text logs into automated treatment checklists and harvest timelines.
ideas.problem_statement: Both halves must be wired together by the end, forming a System that can walk a user through diagnosing soil, choosing crops, and guiding them all the way to harvest.
ideas.title: HarvestLoop: Automated Soil-to-Yield Diagnostic Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasises a flawless live integration demo, ensuring that the critical handoff between the two laptops does not fail during evaluation.
